## Workload

Elif Sahin completed 725 reads during the quarter, working a total of 418 hours. This represents an average of 1.7 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in the context of the expected reading activity for the period.

## Quality

A sample of 55 reads was checked as part of the quality review. Agreement was recorded at 78.2 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in future assessments.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. Overall, the review records the volume of work undertaken and the quality outcome identified through the checked sample.
